research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Bristol-Myers Squibb is actively researching and developing therapies targeting cancer and autoimmune diseases. They are working on antibodies that bind to human PAD4 and CD40, as well as LAG-3 positive tumors. Their research includes the development of WEE1 degradation compounds for cancer treatment and heterocyclic compounds for modulating BCL6. Additionally, they are exploring the use of anti-PD-1 and anti-CD30 antibodies in lymphoma treatment. These efforts highlight their focus on innovative cancer therapies and immune modulation.

about_short_description.short_description: Bristol-Myers Squibb engages in the discovery, development, licensing, manufacturing, marketing, distribution and sale of pharmaceuticals.

product.name: Eliquis (apixaban)
product.description: An oral anticoagulant used to reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in eligible patients with atrial fibrillation and to treat or prevent certain blood clots.

product.name: Opdivo (nivolumab)
product.description: An injectable PD-1 immune checkpoint inhibitor used alone or with other therapies for multiple types of cancer.

product.name: Revlimid (lenalidomide)
product.description: An oral immunomodulatory medicine used primarily to treat multiple myeloma and certain blood disorders.

product.name: Yervoy (ipilimumab)
product.description: An injectable CTLA-4 immune checkpoint inhibitor used for several cancers, often in combination with other immunotherapies.

product.name: Orencia (abatacept)
product.description: An immunomodulatory biologic used to reduce signs and symptoms of selected inflammatory autoimmune diseases, including rheumatoid arthritis.

product.name: Camzyos (mavacamten)
product.description: An oral cardiac myosin inhibitor used to treat adults with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
